overview: Series examining the relationship between culture and the natural environment, presented by art historian Simon Schama.
title: Landscape and Memory

overview: Australia by Design: Innovations is all about Australian innovation, ingenuity and design excellence. It's about inspiration, disruption and changing the game. Join us as we feature 40 innovations that will leave you captivated!
title: Australia By Design: Innovations

overview: Clementine Jones and her best friend Imogen had so many plans for high school but when a car accident leaves Imogen in a coma, Clementine decides to vlog her day-to-day life so Imogen can catch up on all the drama at Attaway High when she gets back, and along the way, Clem learns a thing or two about how to survive high school.
title: How to Survive

overview: Your home of quick, tasty, good food. Cooking healthy and delicious meals has never been easier with Luke Hines in your kitchen.
title: Cook with Luke

overview: Lin Muxuan disguises Xu Zhaozhao to attract a hidden enemy for revenge. During their time running a beauty shop together, he falls for her lively personality, while their secrets and true intentions slowly unravel.
title: The Glamorouse Revenge

overview: In this tale, there was a mythical Jade is said to cure all illnesses but carries a deadly curse that only the heart's blood of a woman from the Ruan family can lift. To break his fate of dying before 30, Gu Suizhi devises a plan to make the orphaned Ruan Shu fall in love with him. As they struggle between love and redemption, they unknowingly awaken a past-life grudge...
title: Fateful Love

overview: Polish crime/drama series which is a continuation of the series "Officer", with returning cast and introducing new characters.
title: Oficerowie

overview: 17-year-old outsider Niah is surrounded by spoiled rich kids after somehow ending up at Camp Be Better, a cushy alternative to community service for the offspring of the rich and famous.
title: Camp Be Better

overview: The 4PM Club follows the hijinks, romances, and friendships of a group of Attaway Middle School students who find themselves in the unenviable position of spending their afternoons stuck in detention.
title: The 4PM Club

overview: Are you ready for a brand new dance show? The jury consists of the stars of your favorite projects, and the best teams of the country are on stage. Each team has three competitions ahead: a team number, a freestyle battle and a Tribute competition, in which teams create numbers on a given topic. Pure excitement and honest emotions are all that you have missed so much.
title: Лига танца

overview: Karan has dreamt of Kliao Khluen all her life. From a deep bond, their feelings slowly blossom into love. Each time Kliao Khluen is in danger, Karan receives mysterious visions warning her of the impending peril. Using her special power—time reversal—Karan rewinds time to protect Kliao Khluen. But every time she turns back time, it comes at the cost of a life, bringing new problems and greater dangers. Their relationship may not be destined for a happily-ever-after, but rather a heartbreaking loss. Join them as they embark on a journey to discover the true love between Karan and Kliao Khluen, navigating the flow of time reversal and unraveling the mysteries behind the visions that continue to haunt their memories.
title: Reverse with Me

overview: Inspector of the State Police HQ, Marek Kaszowski, is heading his own team of officers. One day the Internal Affairs attach a young detective Joanna Majewska to his merry bunch of misfits. She is to learn from Kaszowski, but also... investigate her new boss.
title: Paradoks

overview: Tales From Oak Island explores the most captivating theories, legendary figures, and momentous events surrounding Oak Island. Offering new information and key flashbacks, the series dives deeper than ever before into the incredible people, fascinating theories, and critical discoveries made by the many searchers who have devoted their lives to unlocking the locale's many secrets and treasures. What could be hidden in the vault deep under Oak Island? Priceless religious relics connected to the Knights Templar? A stolen haul of silver from a sunken Spanish galleon? The spoils from a colonial-era military victory in the Caribbean? Could they all be connected to the same mysterious group of medieval conspirators? Mysteries will be explored and secrets will be revealed by those who have studied, explored and lived through one of the longest running treasure hunts known to man.
title: Tales From Oak Island

overview: Game designer Qing Wan falls into a long coma after a car accident. Her fiancé, Lin Xian, CEO of a top gaming company, tries to revive her by connecting her consciousness to the "Dreamscape" engine, a simulation system that has replicated the real world. However, when Lin Xian enters this simulated world, he discovers that Qing Wan has forgotten him... To help Qing Wan regain her memories, Lin Xian encourages her to develop a game about dreams called "Qing Wan's Forest." Slowly, Qing Wan's memories begin to come back to her. Meanwhile, Lin Xian's main competitor, He Fan, plots to steal the technology behind "Dreamscape." He bribes Lin Xian's assistant, He Lanxue, to plant a virus in the simulation, making the dream world increasingly perilous. Faced with these dangers, Lin Xian decides to sacrifice himself to rescue Qing Wan. At the same time, Qing Wan embarks on her journey of awakening..
title: This World is Not Real

overview: It's a bit like Bosco meets Stranger Things as RTÉ One broadcasts a brand-new four-part mini-series for the whole family - and mixes the nostalgic with the surreal. Set in Lough Dan in Wicklow, where the Kelly clan decamp to for a reluctant family Holiday. But the dilapidated holiday park isn't as dull as it initially seems to 12-year-old Kevin, his screen-obsessed sister Katie and their distracted parents Mary and Tom. In fact, before long, things get really weird.
title: The Unreal

overview: Documentary series on the tragic fate of Quebec's greatest boxers of the 80s and 90s, the Hilton brothers: Dave, Matthew and Alex. Marie-Claude Savard tells the incredible story of this family, gathers disturbing secrets about the involvement of the Montreal mafia, and accompanies Alex Hilton as he tries to put his life back together.
title: Être un Hilton

overview: Journey with Destination Celebrity as it explores global hotspots from Hollywood to Paris, Saint Tropez, and Byron Bay, blending pop culture with travel envy.
title: Destination Celebrity

overview: Nestled in the unexplored depths of South America, the tropical rainforests of Guyana remain largely unknown. The secrets of this unspoiled paradise are less well-known than those of the Amazon, despite it being home to a breathtaking array of species. The king of this wildlife diversity, the jaguar, sits enthroned in the shadow of the jungle. This young male is ready to embark upon the most important mission of his life. He must find a kingdom of his own. His journey will take him through changing habitats, each with its own cast of animal characters. He will face other top predators, such as majestic caimans, impressive arapaima, and playful giant otters. Viewers have a front-row seat as the jaguar fights for his place at the top of the jungle hierarchy.
title: Guyana

overview: Watch this year's batch of eco-conscious young designers as they set to up-cycle the way we think about fashion. Presented by Faye Shortt with backstage access from India Sasha.
title: Junk Kouture Dublin City Final

overview: In a castle, 22 strangers compete in a game of deception. Traitors secretly eliminate players nightly while Faithfuls try to identify them. All compete in missions for €50,000, but surviving Traitors steal everything if undetected.
title: The Traitors Ireland

overview: The Puerto Rican Princess takes her cabaret to Texas where everything is bigger...including the drama.
title: Joseline's Cabaret Texas

overview: Continuation of Polish crime/drama TV series "Oficer" and "Oficerowie" (eng. "Oficers") with returning cast. This third installment focuses on global terrorism.
title: Trzeci Oficer

overview: Comedy about friends, family and relationships. Louise is single, bright and attractive and, although she likes her independence, would love to meet Mr Right. Or at least Mr Reasonably OK...
title: Dressing for Breakfast

overview: When Maureen Lessing's husband dies suddenly, she discovers that there was a lot more to his life than she knew. Maureen, an Irish woman who has been living in Germany for a number of years, travels to Ireland in an effort to piece together her late husband's double life, but gets more than she bargained for in the process.
title: Relative Strangers

overview: Comedy about a happy-go-lucky loner who lived a life free of responsibility until his unsuspected and unknown teenage son appears.
title: Relative Strangers

overview: A close-knit queer friend group, struggle with the task of diversifying the line up of their school's GSA, Gay Straight Alliance, with more than themselves, before the two week deadline that will lead to the club's demise.
title: Hetero

overview: They say you can take the boy out of the country, but what happens when you take four ‘city slickers' back to the whenua and ask them to hunt for their kai? Funded by NZ On Air, HAUTUTŪ HUNTERS is a six-part series premiering on Tuesday 7 November at 9.00 PM on Whakaata Māori and MĀORI+. The series follows popular Māori & Pasifika personalities Beulah Koale (Sala'ilua, Savai'I, Aele Fou,Upolu), Jordan Vaha'akolo (Ngāpuhi, Ngāti Whātua, Ngāti Maniapoto), Te Kohe Tuhaka (Ngāti Porou, Ngai Tūhoe), and Xavier Horan (Ngāti Awa, Ngāti Pikiāo, Ngāti Pūkenga) who journey back to their respective hau kāinga in Aotearoa and the Pacific.
title: Haututu Hunters

overview: DanceRites, Australia's national First Nations dance competition, returns bigger and better than ever at Bennelong Point. Join us for a celebration of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander culture.
title: Dance Rites

overview: TV cook and award-winning food writer, Donal Skehan immerses himself in the lives and kitchens of people of various faiths, to discover how the food we eat – and choose not to – expresses who we are and what we believe. In his pursuit of culinary enlightenment, Donal spends time with Hare Krishna, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim, Orthodox Christian and Sikh communities and reflects on the traditions and beliefs he wants to pass on to his own family as he explores notions of ‘food for the soul' from all angles.
title: Donal's Feasts, Fasts and Festivals

overview: Get ready to dive into the glamorous, high-stakes world of Melbourne's luxury real estate market with the dramatic new series Listing Melbourne, premiering on Wednesday, October 23 at 8.30pm Channel 9 and 9Now. Listing Melbourne pulls back the curtain on one of the world's most dynamic property markets, where opulent homes, multi-million-dollar deals and cutthroat competition are the daily reality for five elite real estate agents. Viewers will see the intense pressure these professionals face as they juggle demanding clients, navigate fierce rivalries, and seal deals that can change their careers. But it's not just about the properties. Listing Melbourne delves into the personal lives of these agents, offering an intimate and unfiltered look at the struggles, secrets and relationships that can make or break them in business and life. From emotional meltdowns to high-stakes negotiations, Listing Melbourne is set to become your next must-watch TV show, showcasing all the ambition and drama fuelling the battle for Melbourne's coveted blue-chip addresses. Expect fierce rivalries, shocking revelations, and a rollercoaster of emotions as these agents push their limits to stay on top in this ultra-competitive real estate battle.
title: Listing Melbourne

overview: This documentary series follows professional snowboarder Travis Rice and director Curt Morgan as they risk it all to make the film of their dreams.
title: Art of Flight: The Series

overview: Experience a never-before-seen adventure as a team of strangers embarks on a 1,200-mile journey across America's wildest long trail.
title: THRU: The Pacific Northwest

overview: Finnerty will look to cut through the noise to bring unfiltered truth, sharp debates, and a focus on the most pressing issues facing America today while standing up for American values.
title: Finnerty

overview: Working 9 to 5 sucks. The corporate machine only gives us a weekend to really live, but how much can you do in just 64 hrs? Now, two athletes are on a mission to show us how to take back the weekend and BEAT MONDAY. Beat Monday is a series of epic weekend adventures designed to push the boundaries of what's possible between Friday night and Monday morning. Along the way, adventure athletes Mike Chambers and Jason Antin get into crazy situations, inspire the audience with their perseverance and discover local cultures outside our daily bubble.
title: Beat Monday

overview: Adaptive backcountry riding like you've never seen before. Come along for the biggest days with Karl Fostvedt, Michelle Parker, Katie Burrell, Daron Rahlves and more in Daymaker: The Series.
title: Warren Miller's Daymaker: The Series

overview: INSIDE THE BLACK BOX spotlights the greatest artists of color, from actors to producers to directors, writers and musicians, and reflects on how one's complexion affected their journey to success.
title: Inside the Black Box

overview: In season one, athlete pranks include the NFL's Baker Mayfield from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who goes undercover to blow the minds of Bucs diehards.
title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers

overview: Culinary masterminds compete in a series of challenges created by the most unhinged comedians.
title: Gastronauts

overview: Cyril Lignac sets off to crisscross the country to find THE best recipe in France alongside two experts in their field: Stéphanie Le Quellec and François-Régis Gaudry. Whether it's sweet, savory, a revisited regional dish or dessert, a family recipe or a pure invention, their recipe is unique in its history and these amateur cooks are proud of it! At the end of this competition, the winning recipe will have the chance to be marketed on a large scale
title: Ma recette est la meilleure de France

overview: BBC2 joins the Radio 1 In Concert programme in a Simultaneous Broadcast for an hour's contemporary rock music.
title: Sight and Sound In Concert
La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !

overview: Układ Warszawski is a Polish television crime series that premiered on September 4, 2011 on TVN. The series directed by Łukasz Jaworski. It is broadcast every Sunday at 10:00 pm on channel TVN. The series finale aired on November 27, 2011. On October 27, 2011, TVN cancelled Warsaw Pact after one season. The reason was too low ratings and little interest in the production. The series follows fortunes of Marek Oporny, a new policeman of the Criminal and Investigation Department in police station in Czerniaków. Before that, Marek have to get along with new colleagues „criminal old stagers": Kosa, Sikorek and his commissioner partner Zuza Szarek.
title: Układ warszawski

overview: A Sociopath's Guide to a Successful Marriage follows Lalla Rook — a reformed sociopath trying to make it as a regular mom. There's just the small problem of a dead body — which she may have stabbed repeatedly — in her living room. As Lalla navigates getting what she wants despite useless husbands, needy children, private school admissions and the trappings of suburban life, she's unencumbered by pesky things like shame, guilt and morals. But as mysteries unfurl and bodies pile up, Lalla's dark past threatens to rear its ugly head…
title: A Sociopath's Guide to a Successful Marriage

overview: Gracia returns to Las Sabinas, where she grapples with a terrible secret and reunites with Miguel.
title: Regreso a las Sabinas

overview: In each episode, The Actually Really Very Difficult Show will showcase one of four exceptional children – AKA the Smartest People Alive – who tackle complex subjects amid the twists and turns orchestrated by a different school who actually make the show really, very, difficult. From animals to Australiana, pop culture to history, sport to science, and food to plants, each themed episode promises a blend of educational depth and captivating entertainment. And of course, no show like this is complete without the ultimate challenge, changing weekly and daring enough to even get the hosts eating a banana drenched in hot sauce – sure to elicit "yucks" from viewers
title: The Actually Really Very Difficult Show

overview: From creator James Byrkit comes a collection of stories from the other side of consciousness. A modern mind bender for a new generation, Shatter Belt dives head first into the deep end of questions concerning our relationship to reality, our connection to the universe, and the endlessly weird paradox of free will.
title: Shatter Belt

overview: Join Dr. Len Necefer on a human-powered journey up the Colorado River, where he explores through the lens of adventure the myriad issues facing this vital watershed.
title: Running Dry

overview: This is the project "Wild Kitchen", where in each episode 2 cool chefs in 32 hours must find ingredients for preparing 3 dishes and, most importantly, survive!
title: Дикая кухня

overview: In order to save her brother who was in a vegetative state, Si Yue had no choice but to enter the Jian family and work as a substitute for the fourth miss of the Jian family to marry into the Lou family. By mistake, she recognised the frightening Lou Xiao as her fiancé. From then on, she was surrounded by enemies on all sides and Lou Xiao, the person she was most afraid of, became the one who protected her with his life.
title: Jin Ye Chen Ni

overview: Ti amo chocolate is a 2012 Taiwanese idol romantic-comedy television series. The television drama was produced by Sanlih E-Television and Taiwan Mobile Production Co., Ltd. starring Vanness Wu as the male main lead and Joanne Tseng as the female main lead. It also stars Michael Zhang, Wang Zi, MC40, Guo Shu Yao, and Dou Zhi Kong. The shooting started on February 12, 2012 with "Love Chocolate" as the main theme. It was first aired on April 10, 2012 on SETTV after "Inborn Pair" and last aired on July 30, 2012. The series was nominated the Best Supporting Actress (Ge Wei Ru) on the 47th Golden Bell Awards.
title: Ti amo chocolate

overview: Ten volunteers with Young Onset Dementia manage a high-end restaurant, navigating the highs and lows of running fine-dining with the guidance of renowned chef Ben Bayly.
title: The Restaurant That Makes Mistakes

overview: When a night watchman finishes his shift at work, he is terrified to discover that everyone in the world who went to sleep the previous night has died. Now he and a band of survivors must stay awake and uncover the secret of this global epidemic, before they fall asleep.
title: The Edge of Sleep

overview: Jun, a mischievous high school boy known for being an expert in pushing people's buttons, and Sorn, a composed, orderly man who absolutely cannot stand kids like him, have been at odds since the day they met. From sneaking salt into toothpaste to hiding personal belongings, Jun's endless pranks have made Sorn loathe him to the core. But fate has a sense of humor. When Jun unexpectedly runs into Sorn in an unusual situation, what starts as awkwardness soon becomes the beginning of a complicated connection. The man who once firmly declared, "I don't like kids", finds himself slowly stirred by unfamiliar emotions. From conflict to closeness, the line between annoyance and affection begins to blur.
title: My Stubborn

overview: 'I really want to give you the best of the world.' In the hot summer of 2019, the 18-year-old Chen Zihao and Yang Yuhang meet. Chen Zihao, who's often at the bottom of the class, accidentally discovers that the handsome Yang Yuhang, the topper of his class, is his secret pen pal of the past two years. Upon the chanced encounter, the two of them take the time to talk about everything and gradually, their relationship becomes closer than ever. But with the looming college examinations right around the corner, how will they go on from here? 'Whenever I think of you, who are you thinking of now?'
title: Every Moment That I Think of You

overview: Yan Lu was being hunted, and in order to save himself, he grabbed Jian An, the young master adopted by the Jian family. After escaping, Jian An wanted revenge on Yan Lu and kidnapped him the next day. Jian An became interested in Yan Lu and asked Yan Lu to be his bodyguard. Yan Lu was forced to agree. Jian An uses various methods to "torture" Yan Lu every day. One day, the two of them were fighting, and their clothes got wet. When Yan Lu changed his clothes, the birthmark on his lower back was revealed. The hidden mystery of his life experience was revealed, and the conspiracy began to brew quietly. Jian An accidentally loses his memory and relies deeply on Yan Lu, who had always protected him. The two secretly fall in love...
title: Inverse Identity

overview: RuPaul's Drag Race UK winner Ginger Johnson invites some of her RuGirl sisters round for a good old chinwag… before putting these queens to work with a few cheeky house chores.
title: Ginger's House

overview: Newlyweds Adhir and Zoya Irani's Maldives trip turns tragic when Adhir's body is found buried on a beach. Suspicion falls on their friends, family, and Zoya herself as the investigation unfolds.
title: Honeymoon Photographer

overview: Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.
title: 1000 Babies

overview: Tommy Lynley is a brilliant police detective but an outsider in the force – simply by virtue of his aristocratic upbringing. He is paired with Barbara Havers, a sergeant with a maverick attitude and a working-class background. With seemingly nothing in common and against all odds, the mismatched duo of Lynley and Havers become a formidable team, bonded by their desire to see justice done.
title: Lynley

overview: Mark Zuckerberg originally created Facebook to connect the world, but many now question whether the apps under the social media platform's parent company Meta, including Instagram, are causing more harm than good. This eye-opening seven-part 7NEWS documentary vodcast and podcast interview series coming exclusively to 7NEWS.com.au and 7plus,dives deep into the profound impact of Meta's platforms on our lives and society, examining whether we are facing genuine threats to our children and communities, rather than just moral panic. Featuring insights from whistleblowers, insiders and researchers – including Meta whistleblower and former Facebook engineering director Arturo Bejar, News Corp Australia Executive Chairman Michael Miller, cybercrime analyst Paul Raffile, leading disinformation researcher Joan Donovan, and social media reform advocate Nicki Reisberg – the series sheds light on the true motivations and methods behind the tech giant's operations. Hosted by 7NEWS Spotlight's Michael Usher and Sarah Greenhalgh, the interview series offers practical tips for keeping children safe online. It also features Wayne Holdsworth, who shares the heartbreaking story of losing his son, Mac, to suicide after he was targeted online via Instagram.
title: Meta Exposed: Secrets from Inside the Tech Giant

overview: Marking 20 years since one of the deadliest natural disasters in history which spanned 14 countries, Tsunami: Race Against Time provides a 360-degree view into the heart-stopping events of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami. The powerful series, from executive producers Tanya Winston and Danny Horan of multi-award-winning Blast Films and directed by Daniel Bogado, Emmy Award-winning filmmaker of Nat Geo's "9/11: One Day in America," features personal accounts from survivors, scientists who raced against time to understand the catastrophic disaster and warn the world, journalists who broke the shocking news, and the fearless rescuers who risked their lives to save others. Told through harrowing video and gripping stories of survival and courage – some both seen and heard for the first time – the four-part series offers a comprehensive and immersive look at the destructive wave as it surged across the ocean, leaving a trail of devastation in its wake.
title: Tsunami: Race Against Time

overview: A story about parting, recovering from the "end of the world", navigating modern relationships and relationships, sex and the reality of constant change. "When is the wedding?" is a comedy-drama that naturally tells about the world of today's young people, with contemporary dialogues and ironic, intelligent humour.
title: Kiedy ślub?

overview: A collection of documentaries by France 3's regional network, broadcast in each of France's 13 regions, covering major social issues.
title: La France en vrai

overview: The Last Woodsmen takes us deep into the secluded wilderness with these courageous and highly skilled loggers as they literally risk their lives. It's a rarely explored, dangerous business which translates to incredibly engrossing television. On a floating barge hundreds of miles from civilization, veteran logger Jared Douglas puts everything on the line to harvest the largest timber in the world. One misstep in this high-risk industry could cost tens of thousands of dollars, or even a life. Joining him at the edge of the world is a tight-knit crew of lumbermen who, with only axes and hand-held power saws, take down massive, highly valuable trees that can be worth up to $70K each.
title: The Last Woodsmen

overview: Extraordinary stories of romance fraud, exposing the lies and jaw-dropping scams of heartless manipulators; and the fight to bring them to justice.
title: Love Cheats

overview: Yu Luo was betrayed and murdered by someone she trusted, leaving her filled with hatred at the end. After being reborn, she vows to reclaim her life. Using her memories from the past, she rises to power in the financial world, only to cross paths once again with the demon from her previous life, Liao Youting...
title: The Dark Crown

overview: Yue Yangyang is an ordinary musician who unexpectedly encounters Shao Yi, an amnesiac who has just broken free from an ancient seal. With Yue Yangyang determined to protect her sect and Shao Yi seeking to recover his lost memories, the two form a pact to support each other through their trials. As they face challenges together, love begins to blossom， only to be torn apart by a painful misunderstanding. To protect the world, they reunite once more, confronting hardships side by side. Along the way, they help resolve the lingering regrets of the fallen Twelve Holy Music Spirits and reignite the divine script, Feng Hua Lu. Through this journey, they mend their rift, grow stronger together, and ultimately join forces to quell the chaos stirred by Feng Hua Lu, composing a new future for the world in harmony.
title: Gu Le Feng Hua Lu

overview: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.
title: WWE Monday Night RAW

overview: "A bodyless crime; An endless flight." One year ago, suspect Qin Hong disappeared after a revenge murder in Chencang. One year later, her boyfriend confessed that her body was dumped into the sea by him. Without anything was left. Both witness and material evidence are available. But without dead body, Detective Liu Wang remains haunted by one question: Is Qin Hong truly dead?
title: Persona

overview: Princess Tilan of Xiangnan, bright and free-spirited, loses her peaceful royal life overnight due to a coup and awakens the ability to foresee the future as a "Blind Songstress." She crosses paths with General Tang Qianzhi, and through a twist of fate, they become betrothed, forming a deep bond. Meanwhile, Prince Zhong Xu of Great Zheng, obsessed with Tilan due to her resemblance to his late consort, seeks to claim her. As war and turmoil rage on, Tilan fights against fate, standing by her love and defying destiny to change the course of a chaotic world.
title: Chasing Dreams

overview: Born into a wealthy and happy family, Song Zhizhi fell in love with Yi Wenhan, a man who rose from humble beginnings, only to be betrayed. Scandal erupted, she lost everything, and fell from a bridge, but miraculously was reborn. In her second life, Song Zhizhi protected her family and took revenge on her enemies. By joining forces with Ji Baijian, the head of Jihong Group, Song Zhizhi uncovered shocking secrets hidden for years. This time, she was determined to reclaim everything that belonged to her.
title: Love Conspiracy

overview: Peem, the youngest heir of the Yossinpaisarn family, returns to confront the family that once abandoned him, leaving him to grow up alone—with a heart full of pain and vengeance from the past he and his mother endured. This return… is not just to seek justice. He also has a plan to expose the wickedness of his father, Thanet, and seize power within the family. But things are far from simple—someone is always there to sabotage him or stab him in the back at every turn. However, Peem does not fight alone. He is joined by Than, a former elite police officer, who now serves as his bodyguard. From trust grows a bond. From employer and subordinate… blossoms a deep, undeniable connection. And this fragile spot—might be the one thing that shakes Peem's entire plan to its core.
title: The Wicked Game

overview: Summer camp standouts Summer and Crystal find themselves in the same dorm. Initially, they bond over friendly competition, but soon, auditions for Romeo & Juliet cause a shift. Pressures to land the part of Juliet come from their respective mothers. Little do they know, their mothers were once fierce rivals in the beauty pageant industry.
title: No Romeo

overview: In 1963, following political reforms, Prince Saenkaew is sent to Bangkok for an arranged marriage with Pinanong. Pinanong, who has had a secret crush on the prince since childhood, is overjoyed. However, her brother, Sasin, is suspicious of the union and initially clashes with Saenkaew. As the truth behind the arranged marriage comes to light, a deep romance develops between Sasin and Saenkaew. However, both must choose between love and family.
title: Love in the Moonlight

overview: For ten years, Halvor Bakke has been refurbishing cabins all over the country. Now he brings all his knowledge with him when he invites six Norwegian celebrities to Raet Camping to refurbish six camping cabins.
title: Eventyrlig Camping

overview: When good taste may lead us to good life, but good taste has a price tag. The tumultuous tale of next gen teens.
title: Taste

overview: Relegation, transfer ban, horror scenarios. In the summer of 2024, the public perception of 1. FC Köln is at rock bottom. But what does the club actually look like? What do the professionals and managers think? How is the turnaround to the positive supposed to succeed? With the new documentary "Geliebter Fußballclub", 1. FC Köln gives its fans exclusive insights. The first men's team forms the central theme of "Geliebter Fußballclub". In addition, the club is also presented in all its other facets. What challenges do the FC women face in the Bundesliga? Why do so many young players make the leap to the pros at FC of all clubs? Who actually designs the new FC jersey? And why are fans of all generations so passionate about their FC?
title: Geliebter Fußballclub

overview: Ghosts Off Grid dives deep into the idea that everything around us is made of energy, even our own bodies. When we die, where does that energy go? In this series, the hosts search for electrical impulses away from the built infrastructure.
title: Ghosts Off Grid

overview: After being thrown out of Santana do Agreste because of her behavior, Tieta moves to São Paulo and reappears years later willing to take revenge on those who mistreated her.
title: Tieta

overview: Participants literally sail to an uninhabited island to get its treasures. All the heroes are divided into three tribes according to the elements of water, air and earth. They will not only have to survive in unusual conditions for a whole month, but also pass tests to get resources, immunity or other bonuses. Each episode, the heroes gather in an amphitheater, where they decide who will leave the game. Only four will make it to the final, and only one of them will be able to take the island's treasures for 10 million rubles.
title: Остров сокровищ. Знаки судьбы

overview: Sitcom that follows the members of a middle-class family from São Paulo living in an apartment in Largo do Arouche.
title: Sai de Baixo

overview: Yorkshire Air 999 gives viewers exclusive access to the high-risk, high-adrenaline world of some of the U.K.'s most advanced medics, saving lives in a place of savage beauty.
title: Yorkshire Air 999

overview: Hosted by the charismatic Montserrat Oliver, this show follows heartthrob Nicola Porcella, known as the "golden bachelor," on a Caribbean adventure filled with love, drama, and unexpected twists. In a luxurious island mansion, Nicola will navigate a group of sensual women, all vying for his attention and affection. But not everyone is what they seem. Some are genuine romantics seeking true love, while others are driven by ambition and a desire for the show's cash prize. Living in a nearby villa, the women will be constantly monitored as they compete in various challenges to earn coveted dates with Nicola. The stakes are high, as Nicola is looking for a genuine connection. However, there's a twist: if Nicola chooses a contestant who is deceiving him, she could win the $50,000 prize! Nicola Porcella, a well-known Peruvian television personality, brings his charisma and likability to the show. After his successful stint on "La Casa de los Famosos México," he's ready to tackle a new challenge: finding love in a tropical paradise while surrounded by a group of women willing to do anything to win his heart.
title: Soltero Cotizado

overview: "Eagle and Tails" is starting a "New Life"! Now the hosts don't just look into the most interesting, beautiful and amazing corners of the planet. They try on cities and countries for themselves and try to understand - is it possible to stay here? The rules are unchanged: one host has a budget of 100 dollars, the other conquers new places with an unlimited card. "Eagle and Tails. New Life" is a challenge to modern realities, when you don't know where you will end up tomorrow.
